Vendored files (unmodified, copied byte-for-byte from the zip; original path
inside the zip -> vendored path -> SHA-256 of the vendored file):

  Tilemap/tilemap_packed.png -> assets/vendor/kenney-rpg-urban-pack/tilemap_packed.png
    SHA-256: 305e71fa778444a0858c33988d45a6b79ea923f500f96079f4378347cf6ad389

  License.txt -> assets/vendor/kenney-rpg-urban-pack/KENNEY-License.txt
    (pack's own license file, copied verbatim, not hash-pinned by the build
    script since it is not decoded/composed — only tilemap_packed.png is)

Only tilemap_packed.png is used by scripts/compose-assets.mjs. It is a single
432x288 sprite sheet: 27 columns x 18 rows of 16x16 cells, no margin, no
spacing (per the pack's own Tilemap/tilemap.txt, which documents the *spaced*
tilemap.png variant at 1px spacing — the "_packed" variant used here has 0
margin / 0 spacing, confirmed by its pixel dimensions 432x288 = 27*16 x
18*16).

All cropping, compositing (layering furniture/window icons over floor/wall
base tiles) and 2x nearest-neighbor upscaling to the engine's 32x32 tile
contract happens in scripts/compose-assets.mjs — the file above is never
modified in place, only read.

Font (Inter) is a separate, unrelated asset vendored from the npm package
@fontsource-variable/inter under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see
assets/fonts/OFL.txt.
